messages:
Anya: Quick sync — finalizing launch social blitz + landing copy variants for Hosted / Reserved / On‑Prem pages. Need two headline options per page, 3 social hooks, a short benchmark blurb for press, webinar theme + gating CTA, and inbound lead signal -> SDR mapping. 48h?
Matt: Sounds good. I can draft headlines for Hosted + Reserved today. Can Jana take On‑Prem?
Jana: I got On‑Prem. Will do 2 headline hooks and a 1-paragraph security-focused blurb.
Omar: I'll mock 3 social post hooks and a short hero subhead for each page. Prefer to A/B test button copy: "Start in minutes" vs "Get a performance quote"
Tia: For webinar theme, propose: "Serving LLMs at production scale: cost, latency, and reliability decisions" — gating CTA: register -> webinar leads tagged "webinar-prod-2026"
Anya: Love the webinar title. Marketing cadence: 3 social blasts (teaser, session highlight, last call) + 1 announcement post on launch day + dedicated blog blurb with benchmark callouts.
Matt: Draft for Hosted headline options: 
1) "High-speed hosted inference — launch faster, pay less"
2) "Production-ready Hosted API for low-latency LLMs"
Using short subhead: "Generous free credits, streaming, and cost analytics."
Jana: On‑Prem headline options: 
1) "Keep inference behind your firewall — enterprise control, Redwood runtime"
2) "Private deployment: regulated workloads, audited performance"
Security blurb: "Deployed inside your network with KMS/HSM support, audit logs, and private control plane."
Omar: Reserved (Dedicated) headlines: 
1) "Predictable throughput, guaranteed capacity"
2) "Reserved GPU pools for mission-critical LLMs"
Social hooks (short):
- "New: Run LLMs with predictable latency + lower per-token cost. Join our webinar. 🔥"
- "How we cut inference cost for X use case by 3x — benchmark inside. RSVP. 📊"
- "Last chance: live demo of routing, fallback, and autoscale for inference. 🎥"
Anya: For benchmark blurb (press/blog): keep tight, measurable, and reproducible. e.g. "On standard chat workloads, Redwood's runtime reduced 95th percentile latency by 40% vs baseline and lowered per-token GPU cost by ~30% via batching and KV caching. Repro steps + dataset in repo."
Matt: CTA options for forms: 
- "Try Hosted API" (self-serve)
- "Reserve capacity" (sales lead)
- "Request private demo" (sales + security loop)
Recommend show different CTAs per page and map to lead queues.
Anya: Agree. Omar/Jana, can you help map lead signals? Proposed minimal mapping below — we should iterate: 
```
signal: page -> priority -> queue
Hosted-try: small-usage -> P3 -> growth-sdr
Hosted-high-usage: api-uptick + billing-ss -> P2 -> enterprise-sdr
Reserved-form: intent=capacity + monthly-commit -> P1 -> sales-enterprise
OnPrem-contact: security-question + compliance -> P1 -> solutions-eng
Webinar-reg: webinar-prod-2026 -> P2 -> webinar-nurture
```
Omar: That looks good. Add routing by company size header if available. Also set automation: marketing-bot to tag and add lead score +1 for webinar attendees.
marketing-bot: Registered event "Serving LLMs at production scale" on 2026-05-04 16:00 UTC. (automated)
Tia: I'll build the webinar registration form fields: company size, use case, region, current infra. Add checkbox for NDA needs.
Matt: For A/B headlines, I'll instrument experiments on page with dynamic headline swap and record CTR -> goal: headline lift >= 10% before we freeze copy.
Anya: Timeline: headlines + CTAs by EOD today, social hooks + blog blurb tomorrow morning, webinar registration live in 24h. Owners: Headlines (Matt/Jana/Omar), Social (Omar), Blog/Benchmark (Matt), Lead mapping + flows (Anya + Omar), Webinar form (Tia).
Jana: I'll drop the On‑Prem copy into the content doc in /marketing/copy/ by tonight and ping for review.
Omar: Draft social posts in the social calendar doc and tag @growth for amplification.
Anya: Perfect. If no objections, I'll lock this plan and create the launch Trello card. :thumbsup:
calendar-bot: Created event "Serving LLMs at production scale" and invited [marketing, growth].
